description: FounderType font manager with cloud font activation for Windows
##: Windows 64-bit build only; the vendor also publishes a 32-bit installer and a macOS dmg.
The NSIS installer is unpacked as 7z; post_install expands the embedded app-64.7z and removes installer leftovers.
checkver reads the version from the windowLoadHref variable on the download page.
autoupdate.hash is omitted: no checksum is published, so Excavator downloads the 90 MB installer.
notes: The client is free; commercial use of FounderType fonts requires a license.
